Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I found a sideswipe collision between two vehicles that had
been changing lanes in the same direction. Driver 1 stated that Driver 2 drifted into the adjacent lane and made
contact along the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 described the lane change as a normal merge and said the
contact was minor. Driver 1 reported back strain and was evaluated at the scene. The rpeorted injury is consistent
with the force and direction of the impact, and the damage to both vehicles lines up with the account given by each
driver. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the positions and damage points described. No
independent witnesses were located. Officers confirmed that Passenger was in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the
collision, and Passenger's account matched the sequence described by Driver 1. Nothing in the vehicle history or the
inspection suggested earlier damage to the vehicle. Driver 1 resides in the same household as the policyholder and is
listed as a covered household member on the policy.
</page>
